open_issues: The validation script's --live pending path marks the live validation CheckResult as ok/PASS while the detail says PENDING. This does not fake Trino/Qwen contact, but a future cleanup should render pending as a distinct non-pass status to avoid ambiguity in summaries.

The producer reports a full-suite result, but only the offline and broad validation outputs are saved as separate artifacts. This is acceptable for the narrow docs/validation scope, but preserving full-suite output would make wrap review easier.
The working tree still contains several pre-existing untracked .tlv4-* directories. Downstream commit/wrap should explicitly include only the intended v59 files/artifacts and avoid a blanket add.
